## Setup

```{r}
# ==========================================================
#          MOFA × DIABLO RNA INTERSECTION + ENRICHMENT
# ==========================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

## 1️⃣ إعداد المسارات

```{r}
source("R/workflow_utils.R")
cfg <- load_moda_paths()
base_dir  <- cfg$external_project_dir
mofa_dir  <- cfg$external_mofa_gene_lists_dir
results_root <- if (nzchar(cfg$external_results_dir)) cfg$external_results_dir else file.path(base_dir, "results")
diablo_res <- file.path(results_root, "diablo")
out_dir   <- file.path(diablo_res, "intersections"); dir.create(out_dir, TRUE, FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(mofa_dir)) stop("MOFA gene-list directory not found. Update config/paths.yml.")
if (!dir.exists(diablo_res)) stop("DIABLO results directory not found. Update config/paths.yml.")
```

## 2️⃣ تحميل قوائم الجينات من MOFA (SYMBOL)

```{r}
mofa_files <- list.files(mofa_dir, pattern="genes_Factor.*_RNA\\.txt$", full.names=TRUE)
if (!length(mofa_files)) {
  stop("No MOFA RNA gene-list files found in ", mofa_dir,
       ". Expected files matching: genes_Factor*_RNA.txt")
}
mofa_lists <- lapply(mofa_files, function(f) toupper(trimws(readLines(f))))
names(mofa_lists) <- gsub("\\.txt$","", basename(mofa_files))
if (!length(mofa_lists)) {
  stop("MOFA RNA gene-list loading produced an empty list. Check input files in ", mofa_dir)
}
cat("Loaded", length(mofa_lists), "MOFA RNA lists\n")
```

## 3️⃣ تحميل جينات DIABLO (RNA block)

```{r}
rna_file <- file.path(diablo_res, "DIABLO_sel_RNA.csv")
if (!file.exists(rna_file)) stop("❌ الملف DIABLO_sel_RNA.csv غير موجود في ", diablo_res)
rna_sel <- fread(rna_file)
rna_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(rna_sel$feature)))
cat("Loaded DIABLO RNA block with", length(rna_genes), "unique features\n")
```

## 4️⃣ حساب التقاطع MOFA × DIABLO (RNA فقط)

```{r}
intersections <- list()
for (mfn in names(mofa_lists)) {
  mgenes <- mofa_lists[[mfn]]
  int <- intersect(rna_genes, mgenes)
  intersections[[mfn]] <- int
  cat("\n", mfn, ":", length(int), "genes in intersection\n")
  outf <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("INTERSECTION_RNA_", mfn, ".txt"))
  writeLines(int, outf)
}
```

## تلخيص النتائج

```{r}
sum_tab <- tibble(
  mofa_file = names(intersections),
  n_genes = sapply(intersections, length)
)
fwrite(sum_tab, file.path(out_dir, "intersection_counts_RNA.tsv"))
cat("\n✅ Saved RNA intersection summary ->", file.path(out_dir, "intersection_counts_RNA.tsv"), "\n")
```

## 5️⃣ اختيار قائمة الجينات النشطة وكتابة ملف موحد

```{r}
genes <- unique(unlist(intersections))
genes <- genes[genes != ""]
if (!length(genes)) {
  stop("MOFA×DIABLO RNA intersection is empty. Cannot run enrichment on an empty gene set.")
}
cat("Total unique intersected genes:", length(genes), "\n")
writeLines(genes, file.path(out_dir, "INTERSECT_RNA_genes_all.txt"))
```

## 6️⃣ Enrichment: تحويل SYMBOL → ENTREZ

```{r}
gene_map <- bitr(genes, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
entrez_genes <- unique(gene_map$ENTREZID)
cat("Mapped", length(entrez_genes), "genes to Entrez IDs\n")
```

## Enrichment: GO Biological Process

```{r}
ego <- enrichGO(
  gene          = entrez_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "enrichGO_dotplot.pdf"), width=7, height=5)
dotplot(ego, showCategory=20, title="GO Biological Processes (MOFA×DIABLO RNA Intersection)")
dev.off()
```

## Enrichment: Reactome Pathways

```{r}
er <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = entrez_genes,
  organism      = "human",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Reactome_Pathways_dotplot.pdf"), width=7, height=5)
dotplot(er, showCategory=20, title="Reactome Pathways (MOFA×DIABLO RNA Intersection)")
dev.off()
```

## حفظ جداول النتائج

```{r}
if (!is.null(ego))  fwrite(as.data.frame(ego), file.path(out_dir, "GO_enrichment_results.tsv"), sep="\t")
if (!is.null(er))   fwrite(as.data.frame(er),  file.path(out_dir, "Reactome_enrichment_results.tsv"), sep="\t")
cat("\n✅ Enrichment results saved to:", out_dir, "\n")
```

## 7️⃣ ملخص نصي سريع

```{r}
cat("\nTop enriched GO terms:\n")
if (!is.null(ego)) print(head(ego@result[,c("Description","p.adjust")], 10))

cat("\nTop enriched Reactome pathways:\n")
if (!is.null(er)) print(head(er@result[,c("Description","p.adjust")], 10))
```
